# OpenClaw Enterprise AI Team Bridge for DeepSeek Harness
Connect DeepSeek Harness (DSH) to a real OpenClaw enterprise AI team.
DSH is the conversational interface. OpenClaw remains the source of truth for agents, skills, tools,
memory, permissions, approvals, sessions and execution state. This plugin does not create a second
agent team inside DSH.
> Status: experimental alpha. DeepSeek Harness is still a release candidate and its plugin APIs may
s: experimental alpha. DeepSeek Harness is still a release candidate and its plugin APIs may change.
## What it provides
- `openclaw_team_health` — verify the OpenClaw Gateway through a minimal, redacted health projection

- `openclaw_team_list` — discover configured OpenClaw agents
- `openclaw_team_start` — start a task

with an OpenClaw lead agent
- `openclaw_team_continue` — steer or continue the same OpenClaw sessio

with an OpenClaw lead agent
- `openclaw_team_continue` — steer or continue the same OpenClaw session
Every task returns an OpenClaw `sessionKey`. DSH does not invent or persist a second task id.
## Requirements

- Node.js 22 or newer
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`
- OpenClaw CLI available on `PATH`
- A running

, healthy OpenClaw Gateway
- At least one configured OpenClaw agent
